gateway.description: Name of the Envoy Gateway resource

agent.description: Python LiveKit agent image, e.g. ghcr.io/aws300/deploy:assistantx-agent

frontend.description: Hostname for the frontend (and backend when host.backend is empty)

backend.description: Optional separate hostname for backend RPCs. Leave empty to share host.frontend.

auth.description: OIDC connection string. Empty in values.yaml because it embeds a client secret; supply it at install time with --set-string, a private values file, or assistantx.existingSecretName. The chart fails the render with a required-value error if it is still empty and no existing Secret is named.

irsaRoleArn.description: IAM Role ARN for IRSA. When set, creates a ServiceAccount with eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn annotation.

existingSecretName.description: Name of a pre-existing Secret supplying backend-config.yaml, agent-config.yaml and livekit-config.yaml. When set, the chart renders no Secret and the credential values are unused.

corsAllowedOrigins.description: Extra browser origins allowed to call the backend cross-origin. https://<host.frontend> is always allowed.
